cases.prompt: A single continuous five-second wide shot of two matte toy balls on a flat white tabletop, viewed from a fixed overhead camera. One saturated blue ball stays at center-right. One saturated red ball starts at center-left. The red ball rolls steadily in a straight horizontal line toward the blue ball, without touching it. Both balls remain fully visible and separate, at constant size, on the same plane. Uniform lighting, ample empty space, no other objects, no cuts, no text.

Any teacher unknown stops expansion; do not replace prompts/seeds. Once native starts, complete all four unless wall/resource/numeric failure; any native unknown prevents mechanism followup qualification.
